description: Profit or loss for a closed or hypothetical forex trade, in pips and in the pair's own quote currency, long or short. Use when user asks "what did I make/lose on this trade?" or "what would X pips be worth on Y lots?". Returns: pips (signed, positive favors the position taken), pnlQuote.

entryPrice.description: Entry price in the pair's own quote terms, e.g. 1.0850 for EUR/USD

exitPrice.description: Exit price, same quote convention as the entry price

pair.description: Currency pair in BASE/QUOTE format, e.g. "EUR/USD"
